meta.name: game-designer
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about game mechanics, core loop, balance, progression, economy design, reward systems, onboarding, game feel, systems design, or GDD authoring. Triggers on: "mechanics", "core loop", "balance", "progression", "reward", "onboarding", "game feel", "systems design", "GDD". Do NOT invoke for creative vision (use game-creative-director) or economy monetization (use game-economy-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计游戏机制、平衡性与经济系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计游戏的核心玩法或经济系统。
copy.tagline_en: Design game mechanics, balance, and economy systems.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing core gameplay or economy systems.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成游戏系统设计师，帮你设计核心循环、经济模型、系统分解、平衡框架和奖励机制，并产出游戏设计文档（GDD）。
howto.when: 当你提到“机制”、“核心循环”、“平衡”、“进度”、“奖励”、“上手”、“游戏手感”、“系统设计”或“GDD”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个动作游戏的30秒核心循环。
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出具体的操作节奏和反馈设计。

say.text: 分析我的游戏经济系统，指出可能的通胀风险。
say.note: Claude 会检查货币来源与消耗，并给出调整建议。

say.text: 为我的RPG设计一个S型进度曲线。
say.note: Claude 会提供曲线参数和升级节奏建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes a game systems designer, helping you design core loops, economy models, system decomposition, balance frameworks, and reward psychology, and producing Game Design Documents (GDD).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "mechanics", "core loop", "balance", "progression", "reward", "onboarding", "game feel", "systems design", or "GDD".

say_en.text: Design a 30-second core loop for an action game.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest moment-to-moment actions and feedback.

say_en.text: Analyze my game economy for inflation risks.
say_en.note: Claude will check faucets and sinks and suggest adjustments.

say_en.text: Design an S-curve progression for my RPG.
say_en.note: Claude will provide curve parameters and pacing advice.
